question: In March 2025, who launched PM-YUVA 3.0?

options.text: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

solution: The correct answer is __**Ministry of Education**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Ministry of Education** launched the **Pradhan Mantri Yuva Udyamita Vikas Abhiyan (PM-YUVA) 3.0** in **March 2025**. • This initiative aims at fostering a culture of **entrepreneurship and innovation** in India among the youth. • The scheme provides support for training, capacity building, and handholding of aspiring entrepreneurs, especially among students in schools, colleges, and universities. • It is a continuation and enhanced version of the earlier phases, PM-YUVA 1.0 and 2.0, which were successful in promoting entrepreneurial skills. • The initiative aligns with the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, which emphasizes **vocational training, skill development, and entrepreneurial education**.
